summary: In this excerpt from Book 2, a tense confrontation at a picnic area unfolds between the narrator and Arthur on one side and Finch and his boss, called Steve by the narrator, on the other. The boss threatens to expose everything, including Dawna Polk's identity, unless the narrator cooperates, and claims they can find the narrator's associate too. The narrator rejects the offer, then knocks both men unconscious with a thrown branch, only to see a red laser sight appear on his chest.
one_line: A tense picnic-area standoff in which the narrator refuses a threatening offer, knocks out Finch and his boss with a thrown branch, and then faces a laser sight.
key_facts: The boss claims he has a contact on the outside who knows everything, including about running into Mr. Finch, and will make it all public if he does not hear from them.
The boss says that if the narrator starts throwing Dawna Polk's name and face around openly, the narrator will be the least of his problems.
Finch admits he made a phone call and that Dawna Polk ID'd him from Courtney Polk's house, so the group may have been made there.
The boss says the offer extends to the people Finch has been working with and that they can find whoever this is.
The narrator tells the boss the offer is not going to be on those terms and says, "don't call us; we'll call you."
The boss tells the narrator, "You're making a mistake," and the narrator replies, "If I had a nickel for every time someone told me that."
The narrator and Arthur back slowly away from the table, and Finch and his boss do not move from it.
The narrator picks up a thick, knobbly stick by the side of the pavement and twirls it.
The narrator throws the stick so that its butt end strikes Finch's temple and bounces off to hit the boss across the ear.
Both Finch and his boss collapse after being struck by the thrown branch.
The narrator tells Arthur, "Might buy us some time," and then sees a red laser sight dancing on his chest.
Arthur's eyes go to the narrator's chest and widen as the red laser sight appears.
